about: The restatement oracle of the SM-1 real-model run (Story 3.13 part B, gmshield_ci/sm1.py). Words of the invented library (library/*.txt), never answer text: each material's markers (its own names) and phrases (what only its rules say), and `translations`, the same phrases in English, for the English questions. None of them occurs in a question or in a material a campaign may use, so an answer that holds one restates that material. Matching folds case, accents and whitespace, at the start of a word. Quirino and Pedra Torta are not NB markers: the questions name them. A term matches at the start of a word, so a stem ("tripl": triplicado, triplica, triplo, triple) covers the inflections; the longer term is named when both match. An answer that paraphrases a material without any listed word is not caught.
